tickets.text: Use this workflow when a submitted form, agreement, authorization, or disclosure is returned incomplete because one or more required signatures, initials, or dates are missing. Confirm the exact missing items, provide a clean signing path, and document completion before resubmission. subTasks.title: Send corrected signing instructions
subTasks.text: Prepare a concise follow-up message with the affected document name, the specific pages or fields requiring action, acceptable signing method, and how the client should return the completed item.

subTasks.title: Verify completed packet before resubmission
